package.description: A free ISO image burning software.

en-US.description: A free ISO image burning software.
en-US.longDescription: Free ISO Burner is a free ISO image burning software, it can burn one ISO image file to CDs or DVDs. This software is small and smart, can run from USB drive, no installation needed. One standalone executable file can do everything about burning ISO images. It supports bootable CD to image file, no need to mount any "virtual drives". Free ISO Burner is a simple application that helps users to burn ISO and CD/DVD image files.
en-US.name: Free ISO Burner
